name: pt-gen-refactor
description: PT-Gen rewritten on Hono + TypeScript. Douban, IMDb, Bangumi, TMDB, Trakt, Steam, Melon, QQ Music and Hongguo metadata with a multi-language UI. Deployable to Cloudflare Workers / Vercel / Node.js / Bun / EdgeOne Makers.

scripts.dev:frontend: npm run sync-version && npm --prefix frontend run dev
scripts.build:frontend: npm run sync-version && node scripts/ensure-frontend-deps.mjs && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.build:all: npm run build:frontend && npm run build
scripts.deploy:workers:test: npm run build:frontend && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.test.toml
